I told Dana that the only deadline on record for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is 21 December. Marcus posted it in #north-team on 14 October, and nobody has changed it in the channel since. I replied in a thread on her message.

I also told her I couldn't confirm it was agreed with the customer, and that Marcus should confirm it before it goes in the tracker. There are no Thornbury files in the shared folders to check the date against.

Dana is a member of #north-team, so she can already see Marcus's post. A deadline date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share with her.
